views.title: Console feeder / 8 ft route
notes: W-C04 / W-C05: 16 AWG copper +24 V / 0 V in flex conduit; one-way route 8 ft (2.4384 m), excluding service slack.
F-CON: proposed 6 A DC protection. PS24 represents an output boundary; supply selection and AC-side wiring remain open.
6 A planning load: estimated drop 0.39 V at 20 C or 0.47 V at 75 C for the route alone; verify load, inrush, terminations and protection.

views.title: Console supply / HMI and KP8
notes: XT-HMI +24 V: bridge 1-2-3-4-13. 0 V: bridge 5-6-7-8-9-10-11-12-14. See terminal schedule for each physical contact.
HMI DC-IN: 1 positive / 2 return. KP8 X60: 1 L+ / 2 M; unused loop-through 3/4. KP8 pigtails 18 AWG (connector limit 1 mm2).
HMI uses F-CON feeder protection; F-KP8 is a proposed 1 A branch. Final Class 2 branch source/limiter and protective device selection remain open.

views.title: Stack light protected supply
notes: F-SL: proposed 1 A branch. XT-HMI 15-16-17-18-19-20 are explicitly bridged for protected stack +24 V.
Use compatible distribution blocks and bridges, keeping this group separate from feeder +24 V and 0 V. Terminal 20 reserves a future protected stack feed.
A fuse alone does not establish a Class 2 circuit; final supply/limiter selection and fault-clearing review remain open.

views.title: Console protective bonding
notes: W-PE01: separate 14 AWG copper green/yellow bond, 8 ft flex conduit route; no DC-return-to-PE jumper is specified.
Main protective bond upstream of PE-MC, and ARBOR shell attachment/conductor acceptance, remain review items.

views.title: KP8 outputs / red and amber
notes: KP8 X60 pins 5/6/7/8 = IO.0/1/2/3. Configure as DO; assign PROFINET addresses during commissioning.
K-R / K-Y / K-G / K-B: Phoenix 2966171, polarized 24 V coils A1+ / A2-, 9 mA typical, suppression included.
Each NO contact 11-14 switches its stack lead on the next pages. External IO.4-7 are reserved; front keypad operation is network data.

views.title: Stack light / red and amber
notes: SL1: PATLITE LR4-302LJBW-RYG, installed red / amber / green and buzzer. Factory leads identified by color, AWG24.
XT-HMI 15-20: F-SL protected supply; Class 2 source selection open. Relay 11 common / 14 NO / 12 unused; coil connections on the KP8 output pages.
Gray = continuous supply, yellow = return. Brown flash common, blue and white unused: isolate individually. No supply to brown.
